# Public Proof

## Plain-language verdict
Public proof for Acme Advisory is very thin. I found no third-party reviews, analyst coverage or press articles about it. The one outside voice is a single testimonial from a founder, and it appears on a Acme Advisory site. That founder calls the PositioningHQ workshop "an effective way to get your sales & marketing teams using AI properly from day one." The same page says he has "seen strong returns" from rolling out Claude. That is the only market language I found.

Most of what exists is about Sam Rivera as a person, not the company. His site says he has spent 25 years building business software companies and helped scale Galvanize to a $1B exit as VP of Product. A conference attendee's post says he spoke at ProductCamp Vancouver 2026 and took the audience through how technology has evolved since the start of the internet. Buyers currently have credentials and one testimonial to go on, not a body of reviews.

Assumption: the profile says "What they sell: Not provided". From the company's own sites, I treated Acme Advisory as advisory, products and workshops for product, growth and AI, including the PositioningHQ workshop.

Warning: searches for "Parallel" return reviews of unrelated products. Do not use them as your proof.
- G2 and Capterra list a document-onboarding tool, "Parallel" by Parallel Solutions SL: 32 reviews on G2 and 22 on Capterra.
- AppSumo lists the same kind of product: 4.78 out of 5 from 23 verified users.
- Glassdoor, Indeed and Clutch pages for "Parallel" are about other companies, such as a cannabis company and a design agency.
- None of these is Acme Advisory.

## Quotes
- "an effective way to get your sales & marketing teams using AI properly from day one." Reza Varzidehkar, Founder, OVOU, on the PositioningHQ site (product.example), undated. Source: https://product.example/. He also says his team has seen strong returns from using Claude. The quote is about the PositioningHQ workshop, not about all of Acme Advisory.
- No other customer quotes found.

## Analyst and press mentions
- No analyst or press coverage of Acme Advisory found.
- A ProductCamp Vancouver 2026 attendee, Daniel Nunez, posted on LinkedIn that Sam Rivera took the audience through how technology has evolved since the start of the internet. The post is undated in the result. Source: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dnunezro/
- A BC Tech Council toolkit PDF lists Sam Rivera, Boast among named people. It does not mention Acme Advisory and is not a review. Source: https://wearebctech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/CCouncil-Toolkit-SaaSCTO.pdf
- Crunchbase lists him as Chief Product Officer of Boast and says he previously worked at PositioningHQ as a Principal. This is a directory entry, not coverage, and may be out of date. Source: https://www.crunchbase.com/person/sam-rivera-17d5
- Directory-style lists of Vancouver AI strategy firms exist, for example RevenueBase's list of 91 AI strategy services in Vancouver. I could not confirm Acme Advisory is on it.

## Gaps
- **Customer reviews:** none on G2, Capterra, Clutch, Maven or Google. Collecting 3 to 5 written reviews is the fastest fix.
- **Named case studies:** none. The only testimonial comes from one named founder, with no date and no figures.
- **Before and after numbers:** none for any client, such as win rate, sales cycle or hours saved.
- **Testimonials for the AI strategy, governance and ISO 42001 offers:** none found. The OVOU quote covers only the PositioningHQ workshop.
- **Analyst coverage and press:** none found.
- **Workshop outcomes:** the PositioningHQ page claims a finished playbook, but I found no outside evidence of delivered workshops beyond the OVOU quote.
- **LinkedIn recommendations and posts:** not readable in search, so any client praise there is unchecked.
- **Name confusion:** "Parallel" is a common name. Reviews and press for other companies called Parallel will keep appearing in search. Always use "Acme Advisory" in full when asking for reviews.
